# Release Evaluation Manual Efficiency Template

Fill this template with comparable human measurements. Leave reduction blank until both manual and assisted measurements exist. Never derive staff-effort savings from developer-machine runtime.

KPI-01 status: **NOT TESTED / PENDING HUMAN MEASUREMENT**. The target is at least 50% reduction; this template records no achieved result.

Before timing, agree the same synthetic project cohort, project count, starting artifacts, seeded problems and required completed outputs for both methods. Use the existing manual process for one measurement and the Local Admin application for the assisted measurement. Record participant roles, method order and any practice separately; do not include training in either measurement. If either method omits projects or activities, the totals are not comparable until both cover the same scope.

For each row, start when the participant begins that activity and stop when its agreed output is complete for every project: collected packages, checked fields, checked Admin matches, inspected/corrected media, reviewed decisions, resolved changes, recorded approvals, or prepared publication candidates respectively. Include human inspection, corrections and retries in both methods. Stop publication preparation before any public publication. For assisted activities, time the human's work in the application, including required attended waits, rather than substituting evaluator timings.

Record raw elapsed time and every interruption or exclusion with duration and reason. Subtract only agreed unrelated interruptions or unattended waits using the same rule for both methods; retain both raw and adjusted times. Use one time unit throughout. Sum comparable adjusted human time across the same activities and project count, then calculate the overall reduction from those totals; do not average row percentages. Manual time must be greater than zero. Retain sanitized observation references and the operator's comparability decision; leave the KPI NOT TESTED if real paired human measurements are missing.

Percentage reduction, when both measurements exist:

`((manual time - assisted time) / manual time) x 100`

No 50% reduction or other KPI result is pre-populated by this template.
